discrepancy_checks.detects: One reading far off the line of best fit
discrepancy_checks.diagnosis: A misread scale or a load that slipped - repeat that reading before trusting the slope.

discrepancy_checks.detects: Measured table disagrees with the worked table beyond the band
discrepancy_checks.diagnosis: Zero error: the unloaded pointer reading was not taken or not subtracted.

discrepancy_checks.detects: Recovered constant outside the tolerance band around the expected value
discrepancy_checks.diagnosis: The spring may have been stretched past its elastic limit, or the zero reading drifted - check the unloaded length again.

bom_tiers.description: Plywood/MDF frame with the spring hung from an offcut beam, hand-added slotted masses, phone/webcam reading of the marker against a printed scale, Arduino-class controller or direct PC control.
2020/2040 aluminium extrusion gantry, motorised load hanger adding known loads in steps, optical scale reading the marker position, dedicated microcontroller, enclosed E-stop panel.
Anodised extrusion + steel spring hardware, encoded load actuator, redundant position sensors, safety relay for the monitored stop, calibration certificate workflow in-app.

machine_design_hint.description: The gantry stands the spring vertically from its top beam. A motorised load hanger adds known loads in steps and holds each one still; an optical scale reads the marker at the spring's lower end against the zero position. The lesson states honestly that the machine reads the marker position optically, while the candidate reads a pointer against a scale by eye.

graph_spec.form: linear, line of best fit through the origin region
graph_spec.notes: Axes labelled with quantity/unit; scale fills at least half the grid; slope from a large triangle. The slope of extension against load is 1/k, so k is the reciprocal of the slope.

observation_spec.precision_notes: Ruled table; column heads as quantity/unit; extension read to 0.1 cm, loads to 0.001 N as computed from the stamped masses.

apparatus.name: spiral spring
apparatus.specification: steel, with a pointer at its lower end

apparatus.name: metre rule
apparatus.specification: fixed vertically beside the spring as the scale

apparatus.name: marker disc
apparatus.specification: painted high-contrast, fixed at the spring's lower end for filming

hazards: falling slotted masses if the hanger is overloaded
spring recoil if stretched past its elastic limit
hazard_profile.notes: Mechanics practical: no heat, electricity or chemicals. Keep feet clear of the fall line of the masses.

practical.outcome_spec: Recovered spring constant k within +/-5% of the spring's calibrated value (target +/-3%), computed identically from the teacher's readings and from the filmed demonstration's tracked marker positions.
practical.subject: Physics
syllabus_refs: WAEC Physics syllabus: elasticity and Hooke's law (experimental determination of the spring constant) - as listed in third-party-hosted copies of the WAEC Physics syllabus; NOT yet confirmed against the official waecnigeria.org PDF or a serving WAEC teacher (see docs/TEACHER_VALIDATION.md).
practical.title: Hooke's law: determination of the spring constant from extension and load

precautions: The load was never taken beyond the spring's elastic limit, and the unloaded (zero) reading was checked again at the end to confirm the spring had not been permanently stretched.
Each reading was taken only after the spring had come to rest, with the eye level with the pointer to avoid parallax error.

steps.check_question: Why must the scale be vertical and close to the pointer?
steps.expected_observation: Spring hangs freely; pointer moves along the scale without touching it.
steps.narration: Clamp the spring so it hangs vertically from the stand, with the metre rule fixed beside it as the scale and the pointer at the spring's lower end.
safety_notes: Confirm the stand base is stable before hanging any mass.
steps.title: Set up the spring and scale

steps.check_question: Why is the zero reading needed if the table records extensions?
steps.expected_observation: Zero reading recorded with no load on the hanger.
steps.narration: Hang the empty hanger and read the pointer position. This is the zero reading; every extension is measured from it.
steps.title: Record the zero reading

steps.check_question: Why wait before reading, instead of reading while it still moves?
steps.expected_observation: Pointer at rest at a new, lower position.
steps.narration: Add a 100 g mass gently. Wait until the spring comes to rest, then read the pointer position and work out the extension from the zero reading.
safety_notes: Support the masses from below while adding them so they cannot drop suddenly.
steps.title: Hang 100 g and read the extension

steps.check_question: What pattern do you expect in the extension as equal loads are added?
steps.expected_observation: A complete set of readings, one row per load.
steps.narration: Repeat for 200, 300, 400 and 500 g, reading the extension at each load after the spring settles.
steps.title: Repeat for loads up to 500 g

steps.check_question: What would it mean if the zero reading had changed?
steps.narration: Remove all the masses and read the pointer again. It should return to the zero reading; if it does not, the spring was stretched past its elastic limit.
steps.title: Unload and check the zero

steps.check_question: Why is the load in newtons in the table when the masses are stamped in grams?
steps.expected_observation: A ruled table with quantity/unit column heads and consistent decimal places.
steps.narration: Tabulate mass, load in newtons, and extension. Convert each extension to metres.
steps.title: Tabulate load and extension

steps.check_question: Why must the slope triangle be large?
steps.expected_observation: A straight line through the origin region; slope about 0.0399 m/N.
steps.narration: Plot extension against load. Draw the line of best fit and find the slope from a large triangle.
steps.title: Plot extension against load

steps.check_question: Why is k the reciprocal of this slope and not the slope itself?
steps.expected_observation: k approx. 25 N/m, within the tolerance band.
steps.narration: The slope of extension against load is 1/k. Evaluate k as the reciprocal of the slope and compare with the spring's calibrated value.
steps.title: Evaluate the spring constant

steps.check_question: Why is 'I avoided errors' not a creditworthy precaution?
steps.narration: State two precautions you took, in the past tense, naming the error you avoided and the action you took.
steps.title: State two precautions
